name: FooterMate
author: Tayyab Hassan

sections.description:
Add a custom footer message to your WordPress site. Lightweight and easy to use.

This plugin allows you to easily customize the footer message on your WordPress site without editing theme files.

Features

  • Add a custom message to the footer.
  • Manage footer text easily from the admin settings page.
  • Lightweight and beginner-friendly.
  • Fully secure with sanitized inputs and escaped outputs.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later. You are free to modify and distribute it under the same license.

Notes

Developed with simplicity in mind. Feel free to contribute or suggest improvements!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/footermate directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Footer Message to configure the footer text.
sections.faq:
Can I use HTML in the footer message?

No, for security reasons, the plugin only supports plain text messages.

Will the message be displayed on all pages?

Yes, the message will be displayed on the footer of every page on your site.

How can I remove the custom footer message?

Simply leave the message field empty in the settings, or deactivate the plugin.

Does this plugin work with all themes?

Yes, the plugin works with any WordPress theme that supports the wp_footer hook.
